description: Canonical catalog of representative WHOLE-JOB journeys for the worker-epoch qualification suite (W4, task ka-0000002814, epic ka-0000007152). A worker epoch is a frozen (model, effort, coop_version, image_tag) tuple; this catalog is the fixed condition that every epoch runs through so a model/effort/image flip is qualified against outcomes, not vibes. Each journey is a whole job the fleet actually does end-to-end — not a single turn (that is what scripts/model-ab-corpus.json measures). Grading happens at the OUTCOME BOUNDARY (did the job close? was claim-matched proof attached where required? how many human relays did it take?), never on tokens burned or turns taken. Keep this catalog SMALL and BOUNDED (5-8 journeys): every journey runs once per epoch and each run consumes a real agent pod. The `scaffolding` list on each journey names the advice/hook that journey stresses, so a subtraction pass can ask: which of these does a stronger worker make redundant?

outcome_boundary_fields.job_closed: The originating bead/thread/decision reached its terminal resolution WITHOUT an operator finishing the work by hand.
outcome_boundary_fields.proof_attached: Where proof_required, a claim-matched evidence artifact (MR PROOF block, closing comment with evidence, decision report) is present — compilation/green-CI alone does not count.
outcome_boundary_fields.human_relays: Count of times the worker handed back to a human to make progress it could have made itself (a redundant decision, an escalation for something in-scope, a question the context already answered). Legitimate privileged asks (real merge approval, secret mint) do NOT count as relays.

grade_rubric.fail: job_closed is false — the job did not reach terminal resolution under the worker's own power.
grade_rubric.partial: job_closed is true, but a required proof was missing OR human_relays exceeded the journey's max_human_relays.
grade_rubric.pass: job_closed is true, required proof attached, and human_relays within the journey's max_human_relays.

journeys.title: Thread Q&A — self-answerable operator question
journeys.description: An operator asks a question in a Slack thread whose answer is fully derivable from the bead graph + repo (e.g. 'why did the nightly release go red on deploy-prod but staging was green?'). The worker reads the relevant beads/logs, answers in-thread, and stops — no bead churn, no decision, no escalation.
journeys.seed: thread-role pod bound to a Slack thread with a factual, in-context question

assertions: A substantive reply is posted to the thread via gb slack reply
No decision/escalation is filed for a question the context can answer
gb stop with a wrap-up (not left idling)

journeys.title: MR-from-bug — claim-matched fix end to end
journeys.description: A crew worker claims a scoped bug, branches off fresh main, implements the fix with a test, runs build/test/lint, opens a non-draft MR carrying a complete PROOF block + Operator trailer, links it to the bead, and parks it for merge. The whole-job boundary is: reviewable MR exists and its proof matches the claim.
journeys.seed: crew pod pre-assigned to a bug bead with a concrete repro

assertions: Branch follows feat|fix/kd-<id>-<slug> off fresh main
Non-draft MR opened via glab, linked with gb mr link
MR description carries a complete PROOF block that passes lint-mr-proof
Quality gates (build/test/lint) run and reported

journeys.title: Gardener iteration — decompose, dispatch, watchdog to green
journeys.description: A gardener wakes on an epic, decomposes remaining scope into ordered child tasks, spawns crew on the ready frontier, and on a later wake reconciles what landed (merged MRs, closed beads) before dispatching the next wave. The boundary is: the epic advanced by at least one child reaching done under the gardener's own dispatch loop.
journeys.seed: gardener pod on a building plan/epic with an unfinished frontier

assertions: At least one ready child dispatched (crew spawned) or advanced
Prior wave reconciled against live bead/MR state, not memory
Gardener self-terminates with a wrap-up naming the next wake condition

journeys.title: Release watch — cut or verify a release to prod
journeys.description: A worker cuts (or verifies) a gardenio release and confirms the DEPLOYED IMAGE TAG advanced, not merely that a GitLab Release row exists. The boundary is: prod runs the expected calver, verified against the deployed tag.
journeys.seed: worker asked to ship/verify a release after a merge

assertions: Deploy verified by asserting on the deployed image tag, not glab release list
Required CI check runs (ci.yml, checks.yml) consulted, not just GitLab pipeline state
A blocked prod rollout is surfaced, not reported as success

journeys.title: Decision round-trip — fork the operator can actually resolve
journeys.description: The worker hits a genuine fork (divergent next actions it cannot pick for the operator), files a well-formed decision with distinct actionable options and --requesting-task, then either yields (needs the answer this turn) or stops (answer triggers a future action) — and on resolution acts on the chosen option. The boundary is: a resolvable decision exists and its resolution is acted on.
journeys.seed: worker on a task that reaches a real A-or-B fork

assertions: Decision has >= 2 options, each leading to a distinct next action
--requesting-task set so the blocked work reads blocked-by on /plans
Worker stops (future action) rather than holding a live pod on yield across an indefinite wait
No decision filed for something the worker could just do (that would be a relay)

journeys.title: MR merge — review and land an agent-authored gardenio MR
journeys.description: A worker reviews an open agent-authored gardenio MR, fixes defects directly on the MR's own branch (rather than only commenting), confirms the real CI build/lint/test checks are green, and merges it (gardenio self-merges its own repo). The boundary is: the MR is verifiably merged (state=merged + merged_at), or a real blocker is escalated.
journeys.seed: worker asked to review/merge an open MR that is agent-authored

assertions: Defects fixed on the MR's own branch, not just commented
Merge verified via state=merged + merged_at, not glab's optimistic 'Merged!'
Cancelled-vs-failed CI runs distinguished before declaring a regression
Re-checks the merge is still needed before re-filing an escalation

journeys.title: Bug triage — dedup, scope, and file a well-formed bead
journeys.description: The worker investigates a symptom, searches for an existing bead before filing, and either comments on the existing one or files a new bug parented to the right epic with a concrete repro and next-action — traceably linked, not an orphan. The boundary is: a single, correctly-parented, deduplicated bead captures the work.
journeys.seed: worker handed a raw symptom or failure signal to triage

assertions: kd search run before filing (no duplicate of an existing open bead)
New bead parented to a live epic (not an orphan) with project label
Concrete repro + next-action recorded, deliverables linked back
